releases.name: A Sister's Journey
releases.summary:
A Sister's Journey is a challenging, fast paced action-metroidvania in a lovingly created and hand-drawn pixel art world! Experience a packed story full of adventure, dangers, secrets and mysteries!

Follow Violet on her adventure trying to find Rena, her beloved sister, who seems to have disappeared mysteriously right before their long anticipated reunion. And if that's not enough, starting with Rena's sudden disappearance, mysterious and dangerous events start to happen all around. With her world suddenly turned upside down, help Violet find out what dangers are lurking in the shadows, and where her sister might have disappeared to.

Embark on an epic journey, in a both dangerous and wonderful world!

releases.name: AKIBA LOST
releases.summary:
13 years ago, six girls mysteriously vanished in Akihabara - an unsolved case known as “Akiba’s Spirited Away.”

At the annual Game Show, Daiki Shinjo, once hailed as a “genius creator,” boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST. But the moment he does, strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi - each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

Yet, the story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.

It all begins with a threatening phone call - and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Cancel the game’s development - or the tragedy will repeat itself."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect his friends? Who is behind it all? And what really happened thirteen years ago?

releases.name: Mycopunk
releases.summary: Join the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a squad of odd robots with unique gadgets, and rid the galaxy of a deadly fungal menace in this hyper-customisable mission-based co-op shooter.

releases.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
releases.summary:
Discover the truth hidden behind a famous vlogger's online fame. What begins as curiosity quickly turns into a nightmare when the doors lock behind you and escape becomes your only goal.

Explore dark rooms, search for useful items, unlock new areas, and solve escape-room style puzzles. Hidden passages, secret compartments, strange mechanisms, and mysterious clues reveal the story of the house and its owner.

Stay out of sight and avoid the vlogger at all costs. He reacts to noise, patrols the house, and can appear when you least expect it. Hide, move carefully, and use your surroundings to survive.

Experience a mix of exploration, stealth, puzzles, and tense chase sequences. Every item may help you solve a challenge or open a path forward.

releases.name: Halloween Tidy Up
releases.summary: Race through a whimsical haunted manor, gather matching clutter into your satchel, return every treasure to its proper place, and banish mischievous spirits before the clock strikes midnight.

releases.name: Woolwater
releases.summary: Woolwater is a puzzle game about sheep, fences and water. Give your sheep room to roam with only a few fences to keep them in. Blocking a stream can free up more land for your pasture — and open an escape route.

releases.name: Thirteen Provinces - Hanren
releases.summary: Play solo. Plan as a team. Build a Three Kingdoms deck and join an AI ally in 2v2 battles. Share the field, set up counterplays and adapt to changing weather. Collect foil and alternate-art cards, unlock bond stories, and bring new combinations into your next match.

releases.name: Uncanny Train
releases.summary: A horror puzzle walking simulator. Trapped aboard a strange train, your goal is to reach Carriage -1. Along the way, you will encounter eerie anomalies and solve environmental puzzles. Headphones are recommended for full immersion.

releases.name: Robot Fisher
releases.summary: Third person fishing simulation game, where player controls lonely robot who are just fishing

releases.name: Cheat Koi-Koi
releases.summary: A single-player koi-koi roguelite in a nighttime gambling den. Read your opponent, peek at hidden cards, and swap your way to victory. Get caught, pay a fine. Choose tricks and upgrades, buy tools, and beat the den's owner Ririka for the prize.

releases.name: O'BLOCK
releases.summary: Three hundred dollars and a shoebox. One verb: name a price. Flip sneakers, read every buyer, stack angles into absurd combos and beat a boss at every gate. Hit a billion and the real game opens: a live economy, real corporate finance, and six banks you can break.

releases.name: merchant GAME
releases.summary: Jump freely through sky with colorful rainbow stars poo and unicorn. Just fly with your unicorn into the sky and begin the journey to the galaxy and beyond!Get rainbow ballon and painting the sky with your rainbow stars!- Enjoy four different rainbow stars! It's really beautiful!!- It's very easy and fun game! Enjoy your trip!!:)FEATURES:- Realistic weather system- Cool and Yummy foods- A random level for never ending gameplay- Game Center support- Personal best highscore- Optimized for Retina display and for the iPhone5

releases.name: SHOGITOON
releases.summary: Checkmate the king or paint your way to victory! SHOGITOON combines shogi with a colorful battle for territory. Face 20 CPU characters with distinct play styles, or challenge a friend locally or online. In-game text is available in Japanese only.

releases.name: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time
Trapoint
releases.summary: A roguelike base-defense game where your traps decide where enemies walk — and where they fall. Block a chokepoint so the whole wave comes down one road, line it with traps, and draft a new one from three cards after every wave. They won't make it easy: they dig through walls and tear traps apart.

releases.name: Superpower Rally: Home Guard
releases.summary: Relaxing light roguelike tower defense! Roguelike progression, plant hero growth, selectable super plants, day/night modes. Awakened plants vs zombies—collect plants, unlock skills, upgrade sun economy, defend your home. Low-spec friendly for tower defense and roguelike Build fans.

releases.name: EDO: Endless Demon Omen
releases.summary: E.D.O is a focused action roguelite where a small warband can change the fate of a haunted province. Control your commander while your troops fight automatically around you. Move, dodge, keep your warriors close, and choose which castles to capture before the Yokai overwhelm the land.Each run unfolds across a procedurally generated map of castles, roads, temples, merchant carts, and rival strongholds. Recruit peasants, samurai, and archers from battlefield troop pickups. Follow quests, strengthen your commander, and turn a scattered band of survivors into an army.Simple controls leave room for difficult decisions. Push toward another castle or retreat to recover? Keep your formation together or risk a dash through enemy lines? As the Yokai grow stronger, every route and every surviving warrior matters. Last long enough and your campaign becomes a fight for survival against increasingly powerful bosses.Unlock distinct commanders and variants, discover abilities, and combine lasting run buffs that change how your army fights. Take on War Oaths for added challenge, or unlock Sengoku: a castle siege mode where victory means breaking the enemy stronghold before yours falls.A steady conquest. A desperate retreat with one surviving samurai. An unlikely recovery that saves the whole campaign. What story will your warband leave behind?FeaturesLead your warband with movement, dodging, and automatic combat.Recruit peasants, samurai, and archers through battlefield troop pickups.Capture castles and choose your route through procedural battlefields.Face escalating Yokai, raids, quests, festival variants, and powerful bosses.Unlock commanders, variants, abilities, and run options through score progression.Combine lasting run buffs and rare rewards to reshape your army.Take on War Oaths for extra challenge and unlock Sengoku castle sieges.A complete game at launchE.D.O launches as a full release, with its commanders, progression, and game modes already included, refined through development and player testing.Current version: 3.0.6.

releases.name: CGC - Cemetery
releases.summary: Car Scamper  is a racing game  in which three types of racing categories are there, like1. Against time 2. Against Car 3. Against obstacles# How to Play :-* In Each Game User has to move the car with acceleration.* Against Time: In this level user has to complete one lap in 30 sec. User can collect fuel jars on the road while travelling. According to user travelling distance score will add.* Against obstacle: User Has to collect all the obstacles which are present on the road within the  given time. Boards also present on the road avoid boards. If you touch the boards score will decrease to 5 and penalty will add to 1. If you complete all the obstacles you will get 500 points extra.* Against Car: Another two cars moving along with user car. User has to complete 4 laps in 2 sec before other cars. Other cars are moving automatically. If user car touches other car that other car will stop for some time. Score will add according to number laps completed. If user complete 4 laps in 2 sec you will get 500 points extra.* Make a high score and post on Game center.

releases.name: Grind Grid
releases.summary: 96 monster cells. Click to kill, idle to farm. Upgrade every monster and Idle Cell separately. Prestige, Evolve, unlock Perks, and conquer Tiers that reset the world for bigger numbers. The grid never ends!
